# Hytale Modding Handbook

> A Hytale server-plugin and asset-format API reference with descriptions, gotchas, and compiling examples — machine-verified against the game's HytaleServer.jar and Assets.zip (currently game version 0.5.9). Every documented Java symbol resolves against the real jar and every documented JSON key traces to shipped assets or decompiled codecs; example projects compile in CI.

Hytale mods are server-side Java plugins plus JSON/DSL asset packs. Start with the overview, then the index of all pages.

## Reference pages

- [Getting Started with Hytale Modding](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/00-overview.html): Get started with Hytale modding — an introduction to building server plugins and asset packs, the toolchain, project structure, and where to go next.
- [Documentation Index](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/01-index.html): Index of the Hytale Modding Handbook — find the reference page for commands, items, world generation, UI, NPCs, interactions, and the rest of the API.
- [Pack vs Plugin Directory Structure](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/02-structure.html): Hytale mod project structure — Pack (JSON/asset content) vs Plugin (Java code), the Server/ and Common/ directories, and manifest configuration.
- [Adventure API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/adventure.html): Build Hytale adventure content in Java — ECS events for instance and zone discovery, adventure objectives, and world-instance integration.
- [Asset Editor Events API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/asset-editor.html): Hook Hytale's in-game Asset Editor in Java — the EditorClientEvent base, button and asset-creation events, selection and disconnect events, and async autocomplete/dataset requests.
- [Assets API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/assets.html): Work with Hytale assets in Java — the central HytaleAssetStore, per-type AssetMap lookups, and a plugin-facing AssetRegistry for registering custom asset stores.
- [Audio System](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/audio.html): Define Hytale audio with JSON formats — multi-layer sound events with volume/pitch variation and spatial attenuation, audio categories for mixing, and ambient soundscapes.
- [Block Definitions](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/blocks.html): Define Hytale blocks — visual assets (.blockymodel models, .blockyanim animations) in Common/Blocks and JSON game logic in Server/Item with properties, interactions, and behavior.
- [Block Animation Format (.blockyanim)](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/blockyanim-format.html): The Hytale .blockyanim format — animate block-model parts (move, rotate, scale, toggle visibility) over time for doors, chests, fire, and mechanical effects.
- [Block Model Format (.blockymodel)](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/blockymodel-format.html): The Hytale .blockymodel format — build 3D models from a hierarchical node system of mesh shapes and child nodes, for non-cube blocks, furniture, items, and decorations.
- [Camera Control](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/camera.html): Server-controlled camera in Hytale — the SetServerCamera packet and ServerCameraSettings struct for top-down / side-scroller / custom views, the built-in /player camera commands, and the JSON Camera interaction.
- [Codecs API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/codecs.html): Serialize Hytale Java values with codecs — convert to/from BsonValue via the Codec<T> interface and the ExtraInfo context carrying validation, version, and key-path data.
- [Collision API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/collision.html): Query Hytale collisions in Java — CollisionModule detection and position validation, CollisionResult data, block and character collision types, filters, and configs.
- [Combat API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/combat.html): Handle Hytale combat in Java — the Damage ECS event and DamageEventSystem, damage source types (entity, environment, projectile, command), and JSON-driven combat config.
- [Commands API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/commands.html): Create Hytale server commands in Java — player, world, and target base classes, typed argument parsing and validation, subcommands, permissions, and built-in arg types.
- [Components (ECS) API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/components.html): Use Hytale's Entity Component System in Java — typed component Stores accessed via Ref handles, Component/Resource type descriptors, and entity composition via Holder blueprints.
- [Drop System](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/drops.html): Define Hytale loot with the JSON Drop System — a hierarchical Container tree (Multiple, Choice, Single, Droplist), guaranteed and weighted drops, multi-roll loot, and modular composition.
- [Effects & Stats Reference](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/effects-stats.html): Hytale status effects and stats in JSON — buffs, debuffs, DoT and transformations, damage immunity and resistance modifiers, and stat modifiers with calculation control.
- [Encounter Manager](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/encounters.html): Hytale's Encounter Manager (0.6.3+) — script multi-NPC encounters as Server/EncounterManager JSON using the NPC instruction DSL, with encounter-scoped actions for boss bars, music, audio state, role changes, member tracking and world-event signals.
- [Entities API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/entities.html): Work with Hytale entities in Java — the Entity to LivingEntity to Player hierarchy, PlayerRef handles, EntityStatMap for reading/modifying health and stats, and interaction chains.
- [Events API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/events.html): Handle Hytale server events in Java — the EventRegistry for sync, async, global, and keyed listeners, EventPriority ordering, and ECS component-system events.
- [Fluids API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/fluids.html): Define Hytale fluids in Java — the Fluid asset's identity and properties, fluid level, light emission, entity damage, spread Ticker behavior, and interaction rules like water plus lava.
- [Localization (i18n) API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/i18n.html): Localize Hytale plugins — ship .lang files in your asset pack (keys are prefixed by file name), generate defaults with GenerateDefaultLanguageEvent, resolve keys server-side with I18nModule, and format messages.
- [Combat & Effects Interactions](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/interactions-combat.html): Hytale combat interactions in JSON — the Simple interaction for delays/animations/sounds/particles, Selector for melee/AOE/raycast targeting, and damage and effect application.
- [Combo System Interactions](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/interactions-combo.html): Build Hytale weapon combos with JSON interactions — Chaining for sequential combo chains with timing windows, FirstClick tap/hold branching, and charged-attack inputs.
- [InteractionContext](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/interactions-context.html): The Hytale InteractionContext — access entity references (owner, executor, targets), the held item, the meta store (hit locations, targets), and item-defined InteractionVars at runtime.
- [Control Flow Interactions](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/interactions-flow.html): Control Hytale interaction flow in JSON — Serial and Parallel composition of child interactions and conditional branching on state, stats, effects, blocks, cooldowns, and placement.
- [Operation System](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/interactions-operations.html): Hytale's interaction Operation system — how interactions compile to operation arrays via OperationsBuilder, execute per-tick, control flow with labels and jumps, and sync to clients.
- [Entity & World Interactions](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/interactions-world.html): Hytale entity and world interactions in JSON — entity lifecycle (SpawnPrefab, RemoveEntity, LaunchProjectile), player messaging and custom UI, and inventory/equipment changes.
- [Interactions API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/interactions.html): Hytale interactions in JSON — the Interaction base class and SimpleInteraction hierarchy, root vs nested interactions, input-triggered entry points, and asset-store registration.
- [Inventory API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/inventory.html): Manage Hytale player inventories in Java — the sectioned Inventory (hotbar, storage, armor), ItemStack metadata, containers, transactions, crafting recipes, and inventory events.
- [Block Items](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/items-blocks.html): Define Hytale block items in JSON — the BlockType property (Material, DrawType, Opacity, HitboxType, Flags), textures and custom models, gathering and drops, and light and particles.
- [Consumable Items](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/items-consumables.html): Define Hytale consumables in JSON — food items with tiers and buffs, potions for instant effects and transformations, timed consumption, and consumable interactions.
- [Crafting System](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/items-crafting.html): Hytale crafting in JSON plus Java — bench types (Crafting, Processing, DiagramCrafting, StructuralCrafting), recipe structure, input types (ItemId vs ResourceTypeId), and bench requirements.
- [Tool Items](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/items-tools.html): Define Hytale tools in JSON — the Tool property (Specs power per gather type, Speed, durability loss), GatherType categories and quality gating, and material tiers with power scaling.
- [Weapon Items](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/items-weapons.html): Define Hytale weapons in JSON — Template_Weapon families with signature abilities, Primary/Secondary/Ability interaction slots, weapon stats, dual-wield rendering, and damage overrides.
- [Item Definitions](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/items.html): Define Hytale items in JSON — common item properties (identity, visuals, stacking, durability), template inheritance via Parent and InteractionVars, quality tiers, and UI categories.
- [Math / Vector API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/math.html): Hytale's Java math library — JOML vectors (Vector3d/Vector3f/Vector3i), the Vector*Util companion classes, Rotation3f, Transform, Location, shapes, and utilities for positions, velocities, directions, and rotations.
- [Networking API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/networking.html): Hytale network serialization in Java — the NetworkSerializable<Packet> interface for protocol communication, implemented by asset types like ProjectileConfig, Interaction, and Model.
- [NPC Roles](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/npc-roles.html): Define Hytale NPC roles in JSON — abstract Template and concrete Variant roles, a Parameters/Compute system, attitude definitions between groups, and groups and flocks for spawning, plus driving the engine flock and marked combat targets from Java at runtime.
- [NPC API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/npc.html): Work with Hytale NPCs in Java — NPC loading events (AllNPCsLoadedEvent, LoadedNPCEvent), BuilderInfo metadata describing each definition, and AI sensor events for entity detection.
- [Permissions API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/permissions.html): Check Hytale permissions in Java — the PermissionHolder interface (implemented by PlayerRef), permission checks with default values, command-level permissions, and permission events.
- [Player API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/player.html): Work with Hytale players in Java — the fluent Message builder for chat text, formatting and translations; connection, chat, interaction, craft, and input events; and player permissions.
- [Plugin Lifecycle API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/plugin-lifecycle.html): The Hytale JavaPlugin lifecycle — overridable hooks (setup, start, preLoad, shutdown), registry accessors for commands/events/tasks/entities/assets, and static accessors for core modules.
- [Prefab Categories](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/prefabs-categories.html): Hytale prefab categories in JSON — trees, rocks, NPC structures, monuments, mineshafts, dungeons, caves, plants, and spawn; naming conventions and growth-stage directory layout.
- [Prefabs API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/prefabs.html): Work with Hytale prefabs in Java — the PrefabStore for loading/saving server, asset, and world-gen prefabs, BlockSelection payloads of blocks/fluids/entities, and placement with rotation.
- [Projectiles API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/projectiles.html): Spawn and manage Hytale projectiles in Java — the ProjectileModule, asset-based ProjectileConfig for ballistics and visuals, physics via PhysicsConfig, and projectile interactions.
- [Singleplayer API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/singleplayer.html): The Hytale singleplayer API in Java — the SingleplayerRequestAccessEvent exposing the requested Access level for gating singleplayer access.
- [Tasks API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/tasks.html): Schedule Hytale plugin tasks in Java — the TaskRegistry tracking CompletableFuture and ScheduledFuture tasks, TaskRegistration handles, and automatic cleanup on plugin disable.
- [Trigger Volumes](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/trigger-volumes.html): Hytale's Trigger Volume system — author scripted encounters as JSON effect assets, and extend it from a plugin with custom TriggerEffect and TriggerCondition types registered against the effect/condition codecs.
- [UI Java API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/ui-api.html): Build Hytale server-side UI in Java — UICommandBuilder and UIEventBuilder, positioning primitives (Anchor, Area, Value), and event bindings for player interfaces.
- [UI Elements Reference](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/ui-elements.html): Hytale .ui DSL element reference — containers and layout (Group), text (Label, TimerLabel), buttons (Button, TextButton, ActionButton), and inputs (TextField, CheckBox, Slider, Dropdown).
- [UI Styling & Layout](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/ui-styling.html): Style and lay out Hytale UI in .ui DSL — Anchor positioning and sizing, LayoutMode child arrangement, Padding spacing, and Background colors, textures, and 9-slice patches.
- [UI Templates, Variables & Localization](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/ui-templates.html): Advanced Hytale .ui DSL — file imports for libraries like Common.ui, instantiating named templates, variables for shared constants, the spread operator, and localization.
- [UI System](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/ui.html): The Hytale UI system — .ui DSL files for structure and styling, a Java API to build commands and manage pages/windows/HUD, and the asset pack of UI textures and resources.
- [Universes & Save Format](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/universe-saves.html): How a Hytale save is structured for a dedicated server — the universe/worlds layout, the per-world config.json that binds a world to a worldgen WorldStructure, the server config.json (Defaults.World spawn selection, IsPvpEnabled), how the creative crossroads is the CreativeHub plugin, and the workflow for moving a creative-authored world onto a dedicated server.
- [World Events](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/world-events.html): Hytale's World Event system (0.6.3+) — author stage/fork timelines as JSON assets under Server/WorldEvent, drive them with conditions, actions and context keys, start them from gameplay config, interactions or commands, and extend or observe them from a Java plugin.
- [World API](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/world.html): Work with the Hytale World in Java — the World tick thread exposing players, entities, chunks, and ECS stores, per-chunk block/state/terrain access, and per-player chunk loading.
- [Biome System](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/worldgen-biomes.html): Define Hytale biomes in JSON node graphs — a Terrain heightfield (DAOTerrain), a MaterialProvider choosing solid vs empty blocks, prop scattering, and environment profiles.
- [Caves](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/worldgen-caves.html): Generate Hytale caves with JSON density fields — cave volumes as density graphs, carving into terrain via Min, depth-band confinement with CurveMapper, and tunnel shaping from noise.
- [Props & Structure Placement](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/worldgen-prefabs.html): Place props and structures in Hytale worldgen — a biome Props[] array pairing positions with assignments, shared Assignments graphs, field/range/weight gating, and prop builders.
- [Terrain Density Graphs](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/worldgen-terrain.html): Shape Hytale terrain with JSON density node graphs — per-biome DAOTerrain heightfields, density combiners (Sum/Min/Max/Mix), noise sources, and shaping nodes.
- [World Structures (Zones)](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/worldgen-zones.html): Define Hytale biome zones in JSON — biome assignment by mapping density to NoiseRange ranges, a DefaultBiome fallback, transition-width controls, and the biome-map density graph.
- [World Generation](https://inkthorne.github.io/hytale-modding-handbook/worldgen.html): Hytale world generation in JSON node graphs — the typed node-graph model, density graphs driving terrain height, cave carving and biome selection, and material providers.

## Source and examples

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/inkthorne/hytale-modding-handbook): the markdown sources plus six compiling Gradle example plugins under examples/ (commands, ui, inventory, entity-count, item-respawner, events)
